headlines.title: Mass. teen charged with killing mother, brother after using ChatGPT to explore ‘fantasy stories’ of family’s deaths
headlines.description: The suspect used the “internet and ChatGPT to make searches for theoretical ideas or fantasy stories regarding the killing of his family,” the DA said.

headlines.title: Surveillance company Flock moves to increase oversight after police misuse
headlines.description: The company is also changing how long it stores people’s movement data by default.

headlines.title: Apple back-to-school sale: Save up to 34% on Macbooks, AirPods and more
headlines.description: Apple products rarely go on sale, but right now several are up to 34% off for back-to-school season. Shop deals on laptops, iPads, AirPods and more.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione admits to killing CEO
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in federal court to stalking charges. He also admitted that he shot United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson, but did not express remorse for the crime. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: ‘Revenge is inevitable’: Iran ramps up propaganda war with violent billboards
headlines.description: Anti-U.S. messaging has intensified in recent weeks following the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, with artificial intelligence playing a major role.

headlines.title: Iran rejects ‘delusions’ after Trump says he wants the Strait of Hormuz to be a U.S. territory
headlines.description: Iran called on the U.S. to “accept the reality of defeat” after President Donald Trump said he would declare the Strait of Hormuz a “territory” of the U.S.

headlines.title: Thousands of Americans roll the dice on travel with viral 'Mystery Vacation' trend
headlines.description: Viral Groupon "Mystery Vacations" promise trips for as little as $200, but the catch, you have no idea where you're going until after you've paid. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler spoke to some buyers who scored their dream trips and others who were not so lucky.

headlines.title: Flock CEO Addresses Backlash Over Surveillance Cameras
headlines.description: More than 120,000 Flock cameras are monitoring roads across 7,000 cities nationwide but there’s growing public outrage over privacy concerns and multiple reports of police misuse. In response to the criticism, the surveillance company is unveiling what it calls a major overhaul to its protocols. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY and speaks to Flock founder and CEO Garrett Langley about the backlash.

headlines.title: Surveillance company Flock announces new safeguards to address potential police misuse
headlines.description: Flock Safety, the surveillance company that uses pole-mounted traffic cameras to track license plates and vehicles, unveiled new safeguards to address concerns of law enforcement across the country misusing the data. Privacy advocates say the updates aren't enough. NBC News' Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Usher responds to look-alike rumors as fans speculate he hired a body double
headlines.description: R&B superstar Usher is addressing claims surrounding his recent performances that he sent a "clone" onstage while on tour with fellow singer Chris Brown. NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Meta Suspends 750,000 Australian Teen Accounts Amid Ban
headlines.description: Tech company Meta said it's taken down more than 750,000 accounts across Instagram and Facebook that it suspects are held by teenagers in Australia. That country enacted the world’s first social media ban for children under 16 last December.

headlines.title: Teen charged with murder of mother and brother allegedly used A.I. before their deaths
headlines.description: 17-year-old Arjun Aravind has been arrested, and officials allege he used ChatGPT to write stories related to the killing of family before his mother and brother were found dead in their Massachusetts home. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.
